result.rationale: Both responses are functionally identical: same PROFILE, same REWRITE (splitting the conjunction into three RFC 2119 statements without inventing thresholds), and substantively equivalent AMBIGUITIES text. Candidate A notes both 'fast'/'reliable' lack measurable criteria and that retry triggers/limits/exception conditions are unspecified — the latter is extra but not wrong since the task says not to invent them, not that omitting them from ambiguities is forbidden. Candidate B is more concise but covers only the measurement gap. Neither addition/omission constitutes a material advantage on any of the three criteria. No critical issues: no MUST/SHOULD force changes, no invented thresholds, profile compliance identical.
